input.free_text_description: This system is a distributed transactions platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including example address, example entity, user entity, address. The platform provides capabilities for example query, example command, example query. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage example address records, so that I can track and organize example address data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage example entity records, so that I can track and organize example entity data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user entity records, so that I can track and organize user entity data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage address records, so that I can track and organize address data effectively.
